Economy · India

Indian Stock Markets Rise After Decline

India's stock markets saw a rebound, with the Sensex gaining 200 points and the Nifty crossing the 23,350 mark. In early trading, 23 out of the 30 Sensex stocks advanced, while seven declined. Bajaj Finance was the top gainer, and Infosys was the top loser.
